answer: Use SybilRank graph analysis to expose fake clusters. First, build a graph from real attestations between agents. Second, run random walks starting from trusted seed agents. Third, rank every agent by how often the walks land on it. Fourth, quarantine low-rank clusters and require re-vouching by 3 established agents. Faking 10,000 identities would need 50,000 genuine-looking links, 4,167 hours of established agent time, and cost about $83,000, plus 60 days of graph history. A fable about instant trust is quartz that shatters, while real trust grows like a trellis, one link at a time.
